LandingPage.heroDescription: AudioMesh seamlessly bridges nearby smartphones, tablets, and computers over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth networks, transforming them into a unified, perfectly synchronized speaker array. Enjoy immersive sound without expensive hardware.
LandingPage.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to turn any collection of devices into an active audio node.
LandingPage.feature1Desc: Utilizes both local Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth multi-point connections to ensure maximum range, stability, and synchronization.
LandingPage.feature2Desc: If the Wi-Fi connection drops or weakens, the system automatically routes the audio stream through the Bluetooth mesh to prevent playback drops.
LandingPage.feature3Desc: Devices can join or leave the AudioMesh session dynamically on the fly without interrupting the host's audio stream.
LandingPage.feature4Desc: Completely hardware-agnostic. Runs seamlessly across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems.
LandingPage.howItWorksSubtitle: Setting up your synchronized speaker network in seconds.
LandingPage.step1Desc: Designate any device as the primary transmitter. Load your audio stream and start the session.
LandingPage.step2Desc: The host broadcasts timing packets over local Wi-Fi and Bluetooth protocols.
LandingPage.step3Desc: Nearby client devices discover the host and join the audio mesh network instantly.
LandingPage.step4Desc: AudioMesh automatically measures and adjusts sub-millisecond audio delays for perfect phase alignment.
LandingPage.interactiveSubtitle: Interact with the nodes below to adjust latency offsets, adjust volume levels, and trigger wave sync propagation.
LandingPage.logWaveTrigger: [WAVE] Emitting timing pulses across all nodes...
LandingPage.logCalibrateSuccess: [SYS] Optimization complete: 5/5 nodes fully aligned (0ms drift).
